name: 98465 · Tacoma, WA
findings: ZIP 98465 (Tacoma) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98465 (Tacoma) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98465 (Tacoma) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).
